verdict.rationale: Kling AI is a video-generation platform, so creating a real-person avatar is a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no consent or verification flow for building an avatar of a real person. The Elements system for persistent character identity is an adjacent consistency feature, not a consent-gated avatar creation process.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can create a custom avatar of a real person through a documented consent and verification flow
